game.title: Resident Evil Requiem
game.subtitle: Survival Horror Dossier & Tactical Walkthrough
game.summary: Navigate the corrupted Arklay bio-research complex, conserve scarce ammunition, decipher cryogenic valve pressure puzzles, and evade relentless Nemesis stalker mutations.

step.title: Infiltrate the Arklay Sector 4 Decontamination Chamber
step.text: Proceed down the service corridor avoiding broken steam conduits. Search locker 04 for the standard issue 9mm Handgun and 15 rounds of hollow-point ammunition.

step.title: Restore Auxiliary Generator Power in Sub-Level B1
step.text: Navigate through the flooded boiler room. Dispatch the two mutated research staff using focused headshots to trigger stagger frames, then flip the main breaker sequence (Switches 1, 3, and 4).

step.title: Decipher the Virologist's Chemical Valve Puzzle
step.text: Enter the cryogenic synthesis lab. Balance the cooling valve pressures to extract the Compound-Alpha antigen vial before the containment lockdown countdown expires.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Cryogenic Pressure Sequence
datapad.datapad_text: Valve Calibration Solution: Valves must be rotated in counter-balanced pairs to prevent nitrogen pipeline overload.
datapad.datapad_code: Valve B → Valve D → Valve A → Valve C (42.8 PSI)
datapad.datapad_note: Exceeding 45 seconds triggers an acidic drainage purge.

step.title: Acquire the Sector Security Keycard & Magnum Armament
step.text: Inspect the security chief's desk in the West Office. The hidden wall safe contains the Magnum cylinder extension and Clearance Card Level 2.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Chief Safe Dial Combination
datapad.datapad_text: Safe Mechanism: Turn the dial slowly to prevent tumbler lockouts.
datapad.datapad_note: Reward: Lightning Hawk .44 Magnum + 6 High-Explosive Rounds.

step.title: Survive the Nemesis Prototype Ambush
step.text: When the heavy blast door ruptures, do not engage in static combat. Lure the entity beneath overhead cryogenic pipes, shoot the release valves to freeze its armor plating, and sprint toward the emergency lift.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Nemesis Lore & Extraction Trap
datapad.datapad_text: Host Identity: The Nemesis parasite host is revealed to be Captain Marcus from Bravo squad. Extraction orders from Umbrella command are compromised.
datapad.datapad_note: Do not enter the underground tram line; it is rigged with thermite charges.

character.name: Claire Redfield
character.bio: Equipped with customized reinforced survival gear, field medical training, and high-caliber sidearms. Specializes in emergency crafting and agility-focused evasions.

character.name: Nemesis-T (Type-Requiem)
character.bio: Genetically altered combat stalker driven by a cybernetically bonded NE-Alpha parasite. Possesses rapid dermal regeneration, tentacle lash strikes, and persistent tracking algorithms.

hardware.title: Hardware Calibration: RTX 3050 (6GB Mobile) / Core i7-13620H
hardware.subtitle: Tested configuration for minimizing 1% low frame stutter and keeping VRAM utilization below the 5.8GB allocation threshold.

row.impact: Eliminates heavy BVH traversal latency; prevents severe 1% low FPS dips down into the 20s.
Prevents 6GB VRAM overflow which triggers severe PCIe bandwidth hitching and asset pop-in.
Renders at 720p with AI reconstruction to native 1080p, delivering +28% framerate boost with sharp edges.
i7-13620H easily manages shadow drawcalls; caching saves GPU cycles during intense flashlight sweeps.
Ensures smooth frame pacing while maintaining instantaneous trigger response for evasion parries.

audio.title: Acoustic Calibration: boAt Rockerz (FxSound / Sound Blaster EQ)
audio.subtitle: Custom frequency equalization curve tailored for boAt Rockerz Bluetooth/Aux gaming headsets to enhance enemy spatial audio while dampening fatiguing sirens.

row.role: Elevates damp boot footsteps, floor creaks, and subtle heavy breathing of stalkers behind walls.
Enriches radio communications and adds tactile body to pistol and magnum discharges.
Clarifies glass shards crunching, door latch unlocks, and metallic item drop cues.
Cuts harsh piercing frequencies from facility emergency alarm sirens to prevent listener fatigue.
Expands soundstage width, providing accurate 360-degree positional orientation for Nemesis roars.

item.title: Sound Design Architecture
item.fact: The environmental background reverberation in the Arklay Sector 4 lab was captured inside an abandoned decommissioned water filtration tunnel in Germany.

item.title: Classic Fixed Camera Homage
item.fact: Toggling the "Classic Surveillance" setting in the options menu locks camera angles to vintage pre-rendered perspectives reminiscent of the 1996 classic.

item.title: Nemesis AI Adaptation
item.fact: The creature dynamically learns player evasion habits—frequently dodging through the same hallway doors causes Nemesis to predict your escape vector and spawn barricades.

item.title: Cut Content Restorations
item.fact: Several puzzles and notes in this release restore concept documents originally drafted during the Capcom production cycles of 1998 that were previously deemed too complex for original hardware.

game.title: Project AM2R: Sub-Terra
game.subtitle: Planetary Reconnaissance & Biomechanical Systems Guide
game.summary: Infiltrate the volcanic caverns of SR388, upgrade Samus Aran's beam armaments, drain subterranean geothermal acid pools, and eradicate aggressive Metroid evolutions.

step.title: Deploying to the Surface & Securing Morph Ball
step.text: Touch down at the landing site. Descend into the outer surface caverns to the right. Roll through the narrow crevice to claim the Morph Ball and Power Bomb expansion pods.

step.title: Neutralize the Golden Temple Alpha Metroids
step.text: Descend into the Chozo ancient ruins. Defeat the first two airborne Alpha Metroids by tracking their aerial dive attacks and firing five concussive Missiles into their soft ventral membranes.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Secret Energy Tank & Super Missile Route
datapad.datapad_text: Hidden Chozo Shrine Corridor: Behind the second Chozo statue, shoot the cracked sand block with two standard Missiles.
datapad.datapad_note: Reward: Early Super Missile Cache + 100 HP Energy Tank.

step.title: Trigger the Seismic Hydro-Drain
step.text: Once the initial Metroid brood in Sector 1 is eradicated, seismic sensors will trigger an earthquake, draining the subterranean acid pool to expose lower access shafts.

step.title: Recover the Varia Suit & High-Jump Boots
step.text: Traverse the geothermal lava fields. Bypass heated steam chambers quickly to enter the secondary Chozo statue chamber to receive the Varia Suit thermal shielding.

step.title: Confront the Zeta & Omega Bio-Behemoths
step.text: Enter the subterranean breeding grounds. Evade devastating ground-pound shockwaves and deploy charged Ice Beam barrages to freeze outer carapaces before delivering Super Missile payloads.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Omega Metroid Vulnerability Stun-Lock
datapad.datapad_text: Frame-Perfect Stun Lock: Charge your Ice Beam prior to the Omega's ground-pound roar. Jump immediately after the tremor to fire directly at its throat, canceling the flame breath and granting a 3-second opening for 4 Super Missiles.
datapad.datapad_note: Avoid crouching beneath its tail; acid dripping deals rapid contact damage.

character.name: Samus Aran
character.bio: Infused with Chozo DNA and outfitted with a bio-mechanical Power Suit capable of integrating beam upgrades, high-mobility thrusters, and explosive ordnance.

character.name: The Metroid Queen
character.bio: Colossal apex lifeform anchoring the SR388 ecosystem. Features an elongated neck reach, armored chitin invulnerable to standard ordnance, and acidic projectile spit.

hardware.title: Hardware Calibration: RTX 3050 (6GB Mobile) / Core i7-13620H
hardware.subtitle: Configuration designed for high-refresh 2D platforming, eliminating input latency during wall-jumping and morph-ball bomb leaps.

row.impact: Prevents non-integer pixel shimmering and reduces DWM desktop composition input lag to near zero.
Avoids tearing at 144Hz without buffering input frames; crucial for precise bomb jump chains.
Prevents mobile RTX 3050 from downclocking to low-power P-states during lightweight 2D sprite loads.
Prevents micro-stutter by keeping GameMaker execution threads off Intel efficiency E-cores.

audio.title: Acoustic Calibration: boAt Rockerz (FxSound / Sound Blaster EQ)
audio.subtitle: Frequency balancing tuned for deep underground cave resonance and crystal-clear charge beam hums.

row.role: Amplifies subterranean seismic rumbles, acid drainage drops, and heavy Metroid landing thuds.
Crisp articulation for Missile fire clicks, Morph ball bomb detonations, and energy pickup chime.
Smooths high-pitched screeching cries of flying Gamma and Zeta Metroids during chaotic dogfights.
Adds authentic cavernous acoustic decay while keeping audio cues distinct in the headset mix.

item.title: Ten-Year Development Journey
item.fact: Project AM2R began development in 2006 by Argentine developer Milton Guasti (DoctorM64) and saw its landmark 1.0 release on August 6, 2016, coinciding with the 30th anniversary of the Metroid franchise.

item.title: Zero Mission Physics Integration
item.fact: The game's engine was meticulously calibrated using GameMaker to faithfully reproduce the responsive ledge-grabbing and wall-jumping physics of Metroid: Zero Mission.

item.title: Dynamic Logbook System
item.fact: AM2R introduced an expansive scanning logbook system inspired by the Metroid Prime series, providing rich biological lore on native SR388 flora and fauna.

item.title: Community Preservation
item.fact: Following official takedown notices, the project transitioned into an open community maintenance branch, adding widescreen displays, randomizer modes, and high-framerate support.

game.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
game.subtitle: Contract Field Manual & Northern Realms Quest Guide
game.genre: Dark Fantasy RPG // Open World Quest
game.summary: Track the Child of Prophecy across Velen and Skellige, brew specialized monster oils, make morally ambiguous narrative choices, and duel spectral Wild Hunt generals.

step.title: The Beast of White Orchard (Prologue Contract)
step.text: Gather Buckthorn herb from the riverbed to brew the Gryphon lure. Consult with herbalist Tomira, set an ambush with Vesemir in the open fields, and utilize the Aard sign and Grapeshot bombs to ground the winged Royal Griffin.

step.title: Investigate the Bloody Baron's Estate in Velen
step.text: Arrive at Crow's Perch. Use Witcher Senses to examine bedroom clues, uncover Princess the goat's whereabouts, and make the critical moral choice between transforming the Botchling or slaying it.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Botchling vs. Lubberkin Branch Consequences
datapad.datapad_text: Choice 1 (Transform into Lubberkin): Pacify the creature with the Axii sign twice during the procession. Leads to peaceful ancestral burial; Lubberkin guides Geralt straight to Tamara's fisherman safehouse without violent wraith combat. Choice 2 (Slay Botchling): Must battle the enraged cursed creature + 6 specters.
datapad.datapad_note: Recommended choice for minimum loss of life and easiest quest resolution.

step.title: Navigate the Crookback Bog & the Crones
step.text: Descend into the murky swamplands. Assist Johnny the Godling to retrieve his lost voice, solve the Whispering Hillock tree spirit dilemma, and decipher the cryptic riddles of the three Crones of Crookback Bog.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Whispering Hillock & Anna's Fate
datapad.datapad_text: Freeing the Tree Spirit: Saves the orphans of Crookback Bog, but the Crones curse Anna into a water hag and the Baron commits suicide. Destroying the Heart: The orphans are taken by the Crones, but Anna's mind is saved and the Baron journeys into the Blue Mountains to seek healing.
datapad.datapad_note: There are no clean fairy tale endings in No Man's Land.

step.title: Novigrad Underworld & Dandelion's Rescue
step.text: Infiltrate the criminal hierarchy of Novigrad. Track down Sigismund Dijkstra and the King of Beggars, stage a theatrical play with Priscilla to draw out Doppler allies, and breach the Temple Guard convoy to liberate Dandelion.

step.title: The Battle of Kaer Morhen & Wild Hunt Incursion
step.text: Gather your assembled allies at the ancient Witcher stronghold. Seal the three elemental rifts using Dimeritium bombs, cast protective Quen shields, and duel the Wild Hunt commander Imlerith by dodging behind his heavy shield bash.

datapad.datapad_title: Reveal Classified Data: Imlerith Second Phase Counter Tactics
datapad.datapad_text: Second Phase Teleport Sequence: When Imlerith drops his massive shield, do not roll away immediately. Wait for the audio cue of the spectral teleport, dodge diagonally forward through his swing, and punish with Igni + Fast Silver Sword strikes.
datapad.datapad_note: Quen shield will absorb exactly one full swing if you mistime your evasion.

character.name: Geralt of Rivia (The White Wolf)
character.bio: Master Witcher of the School of the Wolf. Mutated through the Trial of the Grasses to possess superhuman reflex speeds, cat-like night vision, and resistance to toxins.

character.name: Eredin Bréacc Glas
character.bio: Ruthless elven general commanding the spectral Red Riders. Seeks to capture Ciri to harness her Elder Blood lineage and transport his dying civilization across dimensions.

hardware.title: Hardware Calibration: RTX 3050 (6GB Mobile) / Core i7-13620H
hardware.subtitle: Optimized settings for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Complete Edition (DirectX 12) balancing fidelity with high frametime stability in crowded Novigrad streets.

row.impact: RT on the 6GB 3050 mobile causes severe VRAM thrashing and drops frames into single digits. Turning it OFF guarantees solid 60 FPS.
Keeps realistic strands on the White Wolf while eliminating catastrophic tessellation hits when encountering wolf packs.
Renders at 720p with superior anti-aliasing; completely stabilizes frame drops inside dense vegetation in Crookback Bog.
Ultra+ exceeds the 6GB VRAM buffer in Novigrad, causing stuttering when riding Roach at sprint speeds.
Minimal visual downgrade from Ultra; frees up valuable rasterization performance for dense swamps.

audio.title: Acoustic Calibration: boAt Rockerz (FxSound / Sound Blaster EQ)
audio.subtitle: Tuned to highlight Percival's acoustic folk instruments, deep equine galloping rhythms, and directional monster grunts.

row.role: Gives visceral, grounded weight to Roach's hooves on cobblestone and the concussive burst of the Aard sign.
Brings forward vocal harmonies in combat themes ("Silver for Monsters") and keeps dialogue clear during windy storms.
Accentuates sharp metallic ringing on successful sword parries against human bandits and armored Wild Hunt knights.
Dampens high-frequency harsh sibilance during high-gale forest storms ("Wind's howling").
Provides directional orientation for drowners surfacing from swamp water behind Geralt.

item.title: The Origins of Gwent
item.fact: The widely celebrated in-game minigame Gwent was conceived and prototyped over a single weekend by design leads Damien Monnier and Rafał Jaki using sticky notes and index cards.

item.title: Dynamic Beard Growth Technology
item.fact: Geralt's facial hair actively grows as in-game days pass or when fast-traveling between regions, requiring players to visit barbers in Oxenfurt or Novigrad for grooming.

item.title: Voice Acting Scale
item.fact: Over 500 individual voice actors contributed to the game's localized audio, recording more than 450,000 words across 15 different languages.

item.title: Award-Winning Benchmark
item.fact: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt secured over 250 Game of the Year awards upon its 2015 release, setting an industry record for critical and narrative accolades.
